title: Prepare a suspended child before allowing execution
goal: Perform post-creation setup before a worker executes, and terminate it if setup fails.

selectionNotes: Suspended startup requires Windows/macOS; Linux is unsupported. macOS native execution is unverified.

runtime.name: .NET
runtime.reason: This edition uses .NET 11 library APIs; the .NET 10 code is a comparison, not a catalogue route.

sdk.name: .NET SDK
sdk.reason: Build the declared net11.0 sample with the .NET 11 SDK.

language.name: C#
language.reason: The canonical net11.0 project selects the .NET 11 default C# 15 language mode.

prerequisites: Use a net11.0 console project with LangVersion=15.0. Include the imports stated in the recipe.
constraints: StartSuspended and Resume are supported on Windows/macOS, not Linux. Platform annotations are part of the wrapper’s public contract; callers must guard the OS before invoking it. Windows execution checks that the child’s output marker is absent during setup, present after resume, and absent after a deliberately failed setup whose child has exited. macOS is source-supported and compiled as guarded code but is explicitly untested natively, as accepted by Pingu. No Apple execution, signing, entitlement or sandbox compatibility is inferred. A callback that blocks indefinitely also blocks startup; supply a bounded supervisor operation.
stabilityLimitations: RC2 verification; GA reconciliation remains pending.
macOS native execution is unverified; Pingu explicitly accepted this evidence gap.
